_readme.purpose: The next-morning versions of the two 'expires tomorrow' reminders. When Meta holds a 'tomorrow' reminder back, the journey sends one of these at 8 AM the next day instead (the step's 'If Meta holds it back, the next morning send').
_readme.truth: The code is valid to the end of its last day, so on that day 'expires today' is true all day.
_readme.pairs: op_recovery_expiring_code_v1 -> op_recovery_expiring_code_today_v1 (blank: the code); op_recovery_expiring_claim_v1 -> op_recovery_expiring_claim_today_v1 (blank: first name; same 'Get my code' button). Same blanks as the message they stand in for.
